name: seeds-base
description: Seed foundations: the governing documents and the schemas every seed is validated against.

scripts.verify:schema: node onboarding/queued-entry.mjs verify:schema -- sh -c 'node schema/validate.mjs && node schema/validate.mjs --schema SEED && node schema/validate.mjs --schema SETUP && node schema/validate.mjs --schema SETUP --expect-invalid schema/SETUP.invalid.example.json && node --test --test-concurrency=2 schema/*.test.mjs'
scripts.verify:reference: node onboarding/queued-entry.mjs verify:reference -- sh -c "pnpm --dir default-seed verify"
scripts.verify:composition: node onboarding/queued-entry.mjs verify:composition -- sh -c 'node schema/validate.mjs --schema FAMILY && node schema/validate.mjs --schema COMPOSITION && node --test --test-concurrency=2 composition/*.test.mjs'
scripts.verify:deployment: node onboarding/queued-entry.mjs verify:deployment -- sh -c 'node --test --test-concurrency=2 deployment/*.test.mjs modules/deploy-kit/tests/*.test.mjs modules/demo-host/tests/*.test.mjs'
scripts.verify:foundation: node onboarding/queued-entry.mjs verify:foundation -- sh -c "node --test --test-concurrency=2 foundation/*.test.mjs && node foundation/verify-export.mjs"
scripts.verify:onboarding: node onboarding/queued-entry.mjs verify:onboarding -- sh -c 'node --test --test-concurrency=2 onboarding/*.test.mjs onboarding/local/*.test.mjs onboarding/ui/*.test.mjs'
scripts.verify:onboarding-browser: node onboarding/queued-entry.mjs verify:onboarding-browser -- sh -c "node onboarding/ui/browser-check.mjs && node onboarding/tests/installer-journey.mjs"
scripts.verify:operator-auth: node onboarding/queued-entry.mjs verify:operator-auth -- sh -c 'node --test --test-concurrency=2 modules/operator-auth/tests/*.test.mjs modules/operator-auth/identity/oidc/tests/*.test.mjs modules/operator-auth/signin/tests/*.test.mjs modules/dependencies/tests/*.test.mjs'
scripts.verify:publish-check: node onboarding/queued-entry.mjs verify:publish-check -- sh -c 'python3 -B scripts/publish-check/tests.py && python3 -B scripts/publish-check/coverage_tests.py'
scripts.verify:owner-claim: node onboarding/queued-entry.mjs verify:owner-claim -- sh -c 'node --test --test-concurrency=1 modules/owner-claim/tests/*.test.mjs && ./default-seed/node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM default-seed/node_modules/@cloudflare/workers-types/index.d.ts modules/owner-claim/tests/types.check.mts'
scripts.verify:scale: node onboarding/queued-entry.mjs verify:scale -- sh -c 'IMPORT_KIT_SCALE=1 node --max-old-space-size=4096 --test --test-concurrency=1 modules/import-kit/tests/d1/scale.test.ts modules/import-kit/tests/d1/custody-capacity.test.ts modules/import-kit/tests/d1/preserved-native-provider-scale.test.ts modules/import-kit/tests/d1/guard-depth.test.ts modules/import-kit/tests/d1/preserved-report-provider-scale.test.ts modules/import-kit/tests/d1/create-budget.test.ts modules/import-kit/tests/scale/create-boundary.test.ts modules/import-kit/tests/d1/preserved-guard-budget.test.ts modules/import-kit/tests/d1/creation-remaining-budget.test.ts modules/import-kit/tests/d1/erasure.test.ts modules/import-kit/tests/d1/preparation-steps.test.ts && PORTABILITY_SCALE=1 node --test --test-concurrency=1 modules/portability/tests/capacity.test.mjs'
scripts.verify:boundary-checker: node onboarding/queued-entry.mjs verify:boundary-checker -- sh -c 'node --test --test-concurrency=2 modules/boundary-checker/tests/*.test.mjs && ./default-seed/node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 modules/boundary-checker/tests/types.check.mts'
scripts.verify:portability: node onboarding/queued-entry.mjs verify:portability -- sh -c 'node --test --test-concurrency=1 modules/portability/tests/*.test.mjs && ./default-seed/node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM default-seed/node_modules/@cloudflare/workers-types/index.d.ts modules/portability/tests/types.check.mts'
